entries.381517c47c77a2ac: Manufacture and sale of lead frames for optoelectronics (opto) and of the precision molds and peripheral equipment used to make them. LED lead frames are components that determine the shape of LED products; the company handles everything from mold design and fabrication through prototype development to mass production. They are used in LED displays, backlights for liquid crystal displays, various automotive lamps, lighting LEDs and others. Major customers include Nichia Corporation. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,190 million.

entries.71ede9529f04bf37: Manufacture and sale of connector components that connect wiring in electronic circuits and optical communications, and of precision molds and peripheral equipment used in their production. Centered on ultra-small connector components for smartphones and wearable devices, it combines metal press processing and resin molding technologies and produces them in-house from design through manufacturing. Sales volumes of automotive components are also increasing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,411 million, the largest among the product groups.

entries.dafc5455d186d5b2: Manufacture and sale of power semiconductor lead frames and of the precision molds and peripheral equipment used to make them. These are components that hold and fix semiconductor elements and connect them to external wiring; they cover a wide range of uses and specifications, including lead frames for power devices and small-signal devices and heat sinks, and the company consistently mass-produces and supplies them through the metal pressing and caulking processes. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,152 million.
entries.e008d42a8569ec9f: An electronic components manufacturer headquartered in Uenohara, Yamanashi Prefecture, forming a group with four subsidiaries (three consolidated subsidiaries and one non-consolidated subsidiary). The company operates a single segment, the Press-Processed Products Business, manufacturing and selling by product group power semiconductor lead frames, opto lead frames, connector components and others. It operates four domestic plants and two overseas plants (the Philippines and China), and consolidated headcount for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 1,293 employees.
